output.scope_note: The paper is about garnet Al-LLZO solid electrolytes, but its own measurements are cell cycling and EIS interfacial resistance, not bulk ionic conductivity. The only conductivity number is a literature-cited room-temperature value for Al-LLZO in the Introduction.

records.evidence_quote: offer high room temperature (RT) ionic conductivity (~10-4S cm-1)
records.notes: Class-level approximate value (~10^-4) for aluminum-doped LLZO garnets in the Introduction, cited to Refs. [3,4]; not measured in this paper. The tilde is outside the value. Included as literature_cited with low confidence; the paper's own composition Li6.25Al0.25La3Zr2O12 is not explicitly tied to this number.
